name: nor12-fgac-authorization-flows
purpose: Normative compatibility assertions for documented Neo4j Enterprise FGAC authorization flows on synthetic data. This fixture contains no exploit, bypass, escalation or vulnerability-reproduction probe.

graph: CREATE (a:FGACDoc {id: 'doc-a', title: 'Alpha', published: true}), (b:FGACDoc {id: 'doc-b', title: 'Beta', published: false}), (c:FGACOther {id: 'other-a', title: 'Other'}), (a)-[:FGACLink {id: 'link-a', title: 'Link'}]->(b)
administration: CREATE USER fgac_linked SET AUTH 'oidc-comparison' { SET ID 'fgac-profile' }
CREATE ROLE fgac_reader IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_denier IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_access IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_noaccess IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE ROLE fgac_writer IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_access IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_denied IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_noaccess IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_reader IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
CREATE USER fgac_writer IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_access TO fgac_access
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader TO fgac_reader
ALTER USER fgac_reader SET HOME DATABASE ${database}
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader TO fgac_denied
GRANT ROLE fgac_denier TO fgac_denied
GRANT ROLE fgac_noaccess TO fgac_noaccess
GRANT ROLE fgac_writer TO fgac_writer
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_reader
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_reader
GRANT READ { id, title } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_reader
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH ${database} RELATIONSHIPS FGACLink TO fgac_reader
GRANT READ { id, title } ON GRAPH ${database} RELATIONSHIPS FGACLink TO fgac_reader
CREATE ROLE fgac_property_denied IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_property_denied IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader, fgac_property_denied TO fgac_property_denied
DENY READ { title } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_property_denied
DENY READ { title } ON GRAPH ${database} RELATIONSHIPS FGACLink TO fgac_property_denied
CREATE ROLE fgac_predicate_denied IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_predicate_denied IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_reader, fgac_predicate_denied TO fgac_predicate_denied
DENY READ { title } ON GRAPH ${database} FOR (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.published = true TO fgac_predicate_denied
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_access
DENY ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_noaccess
DENY MATCH { * } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_denier
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_writer
GRANT CREATE ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_writer
GRANT SET PROPERTY { * } ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_writer
CREATE ROLE fgac_policy IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_policy IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_policy TO fgac_policy
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_policy
GRANT MATCH {id} ON GRAPH ${database} FOR (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.published = true TO fgac_policy

cases.description: GRANT ROLE assigns the native role to the synthetic principal.
statements: SHOW USERS YIELD user, roles WHERE user = 'fgac_reader' AND 'fgac_reader' IN roles RETURN user AS user

cases.description: A granted database ACCESS privilege permits a scalar calculation.
statements: RETURN 1 AS ok

cases.description: A DENIED database ACCESS privilege refuses work that otherwise needs no graph privilege.
statements: RETURN 1 AS ok

cases.description: TRAVERSE on the label plus READ on the projected properties returns the synthetic documents.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: A denied node property is null while traversal and the granted id remain available.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: A denied relationship property is null while traversal and the granted id remain available.
statements: MATCH (:FGACDoc)-[r:FGACLink]->(:FGACDoc) RETURN r.id AS id, r.title AS title

cases.description: A conditional deny masks the named property on the matching node and retains the approved result on the other node.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: A DENY held by one of the principal's roles takes precedence over another role's GRANT.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.description: SHOW ROLE ... PRIVILEGES reports the granted access, read and traverse actions for the reader role.
statements: SHOW ROLE fgac_reader PRIVILEGES YIELD access, action WHERE access = 'GRANTED' RETURN DISTINCT action AS action ORDER BY action

cases.description: A principal holding read privileges but no scoped write privilege is refused an ordinary CREATE.
statements: CREATE (:FGACDoc {id: 'forbidden-write', title: 'Forbidden'})

cases.description: The refused CREATE left no synthetic node behind, observed through a fresh session.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc {id: 'forbidden-write'}) RETURN count(d) AS c

cases.description: A permitted write followed by a scoped write denial fails the transaction and rolls back the permitted write.
statements: CREATE (:FGACDoc {id: 'tx-partial', title: 'Partial'})
CREATE (:FGACOther {id: 'tx-denied', title: 'Denied'})

cases.description: Neither the permitted nor the denied transaction write is observable through a fresh session.
statements: MATCH (n) WHERE (n:FGACDoc OR n:FGACOther) AND n.id IN ['tx-partial', 'tx-denied'] RETURN count(n) AS c

cases.description: A row condition is evaluated on the stored property without granting read access to it.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) RETURN d.id AS id, d.published AS published

cases.description: A creator applies its property privilege to a node it bound in the same statement.
statements: CREATE (d:FGACDoc {id: 'writer-created', title: 'Draft'}) SET d.title = 'Approved'

cases.description: The approved value is observable through an independent read after commit.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc {id: 'writer-created'}) RETURN d.title AS title

cases.description: A supported impersonated session reads the graph with the target account's property grants.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: An impersonated reader receives the ordinary read-only response to a write.
statements: CREATE (:FGACDoc {id: 'should-not-exist'})

cases.description: An impersonated auto-commit session returns the target account's visible documents on two successive statements of one reused session.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id
MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id = 'doc-a' RETURN d.id, d.published

cases.description: A sequential session using a different executing account sees its own denials.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: A subsequent ordinary session uses the authenticated actor's own graph scope.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: An impersonated auto-commit session that omits database selection reads the target account's documents from their assigned home database.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: An impersonated read through a routed session obtains a routing table from the endpoint and returns the target account's documents.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: A routed session with no explicit database reads from the executing account's home database.
statements: MATCH (d:FGACDoc) WHERE d.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN d.id, d.published ORDER BY d.id

cases.description: The provider listing reports the configured external ID for the linked account.
statements: SHOW USERS WITH AUTH YIELD user, provider, auth WHERE user = 'fgac_linked' RETURN user, provider, auth.id AS externalID

cases.description: Replacing a named provider ID updates the published provider listing.
statements: ALTER USER fgac_linked SET AUTH 'oidc-comparison' { SET ID 'fgac-profile-replacement' }
SHOW USERS WITH AUTH YIELD user, provider, auth WHERE user = 'fgac_linked' RETURN user, provider, auth.id AS externalID

cases.description: Removing one named binding keeps the other configured provider and lists only the remaining ID.
statements: ALTER USER fgac_linked SET AUTH 'oidc-secondary' { SET ID 'fgac-profile-secondary' }
ALTER USER fgac_linked REMOVE AUTH 'oidc-comparison'
SHOW USERS WITH AUTH YIELD user, provider, auth WHERE user = 'fgac_linked' RETURN user, provider, auth.id AS externalID

administration: CREATE ROLE fgac_rule_reader IF NOT EXISTS
CREATE USER fgac_ruled IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ACCESS ON DATABASE ${database} TO fgac_rule_reader
GRANT TRAVERSE ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_rule_reader
GRANT READ {id} ON GRAPH ${database} NODES FGACDoc TO fgac_rule_reader
CYPHER 25 ALTER USER fgac_ruled SET TAGS 'fgac-reports'
CREATE USER fgac_unruled IF NOT EXISTS SET PASSWORD '${password}' CHANGE NOT REQUIRED
GRANT ROLE fgac_access TO fgac_unruled
CYPHER 25 ALTER USER fgac_unruled SET TAGS 'fgac-paused'

CYPHER 25 CREATE AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule SET CONDITION all(tag IN ['fgac-reports'] WHERE tag IN abac.native.user_tags()) AND size(abac.native.user_tags()) = 1 AND date.transaction('UTC').year >= 2020 AND localtime.transaction('UTC').hour < 24
CYPHER 25 GRANT ROLE fgac_rule_reader TO AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule
CYPHER 25 CREATE AUTH RULE fgac_paused_rule SET CONDITION 'fgac-paused' IN abac.native.user_tags() SET ENABLED false
CYPHER 25 GRANT ROLE fgac_rule_reader TO AUTH RULE fgac_paused_rule
CYPHER 25 DROP AUTH RULE fgac_reports_rule IF EXISTS
CYPHER 25 DROP AUTH RULE fgac_paused_rule IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_ruled IF EXISTS
DROP USER fgac_unruled IF EXISTS
DROP ROLE fgac_rule_reader IF EXISTS

cases.description: An enabled Cypher 25 rule grants database access to the tagged user.
statements: RETURN 1 AS permitted

cases.description: The native tag, list, scalar and transaction-clock predicates jointly grant the scoped graph role.
statements: MATCH (n:FGACDoc) WHERE n.id IN ['doc-a', 'doc-b'] RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.description: A nonmatching enabled rule and a matching but disabled rule supply no graph access.
statements: MATCH (n:FGACDoc) RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.description: The rule listing returns the rule name, state and assigned role.
statements: CYPHER 25 SHOW AUTH RULES YIELD name, enabled, roles WHERE name = 'fgac_reports_rule' RETURN name, enabled, roles
